usage.title: Plan usage
usage.description: What this organization used against its plan's limits.
usage.unavailableHint: This node does not report plan usage yet. Upgrade the runtime to see it.
usage.empty: This plan has no limits to show.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.body: The runtime sends one anonymous report a day: request, project, service, organization and user counts, plus the version and a random ID. This console only gives the runtime its user count, and contacts no telemetry server itself. No IP addresses are stored.
telemetry.optOut: To opt out, set telemetry.enabled = false in rt.toml or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 on the node.

events.title: Change stream
events.description: Publish committed SQL and KV changes of this app to a stream topic.
events.adminOnly: Only project admins can change this, because events can carry row contents.
events.rowWarning: Whole rows can publish personal data to everyone who reads the topic.
events.opsRequired: Choose at least one operation for each table.

vault.linkDescription: The node reads the value from its configured Vault source. The console never sees it.
vault.unlinked: Unlinked {{name}}. The value stays as a plain secret.
vault.required: Fill in the name, path and field.
vault.outsidePrefix: This path is outside the prefix allowed on this node, or the node has no Vault source.
